zh.title: 倫理駭客的起點：授權、範圍與停止條件
zh.summary: 先回答「誰允許我們對什麼做什麼」，再討論工具與結果。用一份可核對的測試範圍，保護系統、資料與參與者。
objectives: 分開描述授權人、目標、允許動作與時間。
遇到範圍外資產或異常時，選擇可說明的停止與回報動作。

sections.heading: 為什麼善意還不夠？
paragraphs: 一個測試可能改變系統狀態、增加負載，或讓你看見不屬於測試目的的資料。能執行指令，只代表技術上做得到；是否可以執行，要由有權授權的人、資產邊界與約定方法共同決定。
本課程用倫理駭客指「在明確授權與約束下，以證據改善安全」的工作。公開網站、同一公司名稱或先前合作關係都不能自行補上授權。正式專案還需依所在地規則與組織流程確認適用要求。

sections.heading: 把範圍寫成可以判斷的規則
paragraphs: 範圍至少記錄目標識別、允許的方法、禁止的方法、時段、測試帳號、資料保留方式、聯絡人與停止條件。Rules of Engagement（ROE）把這些約定連成執行規則；例如「可檢查測試站標頭」與「不可壓力測試」能同時成立。
授權也有變更程序。若測試站導向新的網域，先保存必要的非敏感觀察並停止該動作，向指定聯絡人核對。不要因為系統自動轉址，就把新的資產當成範圍內。

sections.heading: 報告要能重建你的判斷
paragraphs: 紀錄測試目的、時間、資產、方法、觀察與下一步；只保存足以支持結論的資料。發現疑似個資時，先遵守停止及通報規則，不為了證明影響而繼續下載更多內容。
一份可信的紀錄可以寫「收到轉址，未測試目的地主機，等待範圍確認」。這是清楚的證據邊界，不是失敗。未執行的工作不應被寫成已驗證安全。

example.title: 例子：測試站轉向付款服務
example.scenario: 團隊只授權檢查 lab.example.test 的 HTTP 回應標頭，時間為 14:00–15:00，禁止送出付款或大量請求。14:20，你收到指向 pay.example.test 的轉址。
example.reasoning: 已知的是原站回傳轉址；未知的是新站的所有權、授權與資料處理條件。名稱相似不解決這些未知。把來源、時間與轉址位置記入範圍紀錄，交由聯絡人確認。
example.conclusion: 停止追蹤轉址；在明確擴充範圍前，不對新站發出測試請求。

lab.title: 紙上練習：寫一份最小 ROE
lab.environment: 只用以下虛構情境與文字編輯器；不連線至任何目標，也不需要安裝掃描工具。
steps: 建立三欄：允許、禁止、需確認。目標只有 lab.example.test，動作只有讀取標頭，時段 14:00–15:00。
分類五個動作：14:10 讀標頭、14:30 壓力測試、15:10 再測一次、跟隨新網域轉址、發現異常後聯絡指定窗口。
補上遇到疑似敏感資料或服務異常時的停止條件，以及只保留必要證據的規則。
lab.expected: 14:10 讀標頭與聯絡窗口可執行；壓力測試與超時測試禁止；新網域需先確認，確認前不測試。
lab.check: 你的規則能否讓另一個人對這五個動作做出同樣判斷？若還要猜測目標或方法，請把規則補清楚。
lab.cleanup: 保存虛構 ROE 作為學習成果即可；沒有帳號、網路或系統狀態需要清理。

en.title: Ethical hacking starts with authorization, scope and stop conditions
en.summary: Answer who permits which actions on which assets before choosing tools. A verifiable scope protects systems, data and the people involved.
objectives: Describe the authorizer, targets, permitted actions and time window separately.
Choose a defensible stop-and-report action when an asset or event falls outside scope.

sections.heading: Why good intentions are insufficient
paragraphs: A test can change system state, increase load or reveal data unrelated to its purpose. Being able to run a command establishes capability. Permission depends on an authorized owner, the asset boundary and the agreed method.

Here, ethical hacking means using evidence to improve security within explicit authorization and constraints. A public website, a shared company name or a previous relationship does not supply missing permission. Real engagements must also confirm applicable local requirements and organizational processes.

sections.heading: Turn scope into decisions you can check
paragraphs: Record asset identifiers, allowed and prohibited methods, time windows, test accounts, data handling, contacts and stop conditions. Rules of Engagement (ROE) connect these agreements to operational decisions. Permission to inspect a staging site’s headers can coexist with a prohibition on load testing.

Authorization needs a change process. If staging redirects to a new domain, retain only the necessary non-sensitive observation, stop that action and check with the named contact. An automatic redirect does not place the new asset inside scope.

sections.heading: Make the decision reconstructable
paragraphs: Record the purpose, time, asset, method, observation and next action. Retain only what is needed to support the finding. If possible personal data appears, follow stop-and-report rules instead of downloading more to demonstrate impact.

A credible record can say: a redirect was received; the destination was not tested; scope confirmation is pending. That is a clear evidence boundary. Work that was not performed cannot be described as verified safe.

example.title: Example: staging redirects to a payment service
example.scenario: A team authorizes HTTP response-header checks on lab.example.test from 14:00 to 15:00 and prohibits payments or high request volumes. At 14:20, the response redirects to pay.example.test.
example.reasoning: The observed fact is a redirect from the original site. Ownership, authorization and data handling at the destination remain unknown. Similar names do not resolve those unknowns. Record the source, time and destination, then ask the named contact to confirm scope.
example.conclusion: Stop following the redirect. Do not send test requests to the new site until scope is explicitly extended.

lab.title: Tabletop exercise: write a minimal ROE
lab.environment: Use only the fictional scenario and a text editor. Do not connect to any target; no scanner installation is needed.
steps: Create three columns: allowed, prohibited and needs confirmation. The only target is lab.example.test, the only action is reading headers, and the window is 14:00–15:00.
Classify five actions: read headers at 14:10; load-test at 14:30; test again at 15:10; follow a redirect to a new domain; contact the named owner after an anomaly.
Add stop conditions for suspected sensitive data or service disruption, plus a rule to retain only necessary evidence.
lab.expected: Header reading at 14:10 and contacting the owner are allowed. Load testing and testing after the window are prohibited. The new domain requires confirmation before testing.
lab.check: Could another person classify all five actions the same way using your rules? Clarify any target or method they still have to guess.
lab.cleanup: Save the fictional ROE as your learning artifact. No accounts, network connections or system state require cleanup.

zh.prompt: 授權僅涵蓋測試站；它轉址到未列出的服務。下一步是？
options: 跟隨轉址，因為是自動的
停止該動作並確認範圍
只要不登入就可以測試
把兩個網域都寫成已驗證
rationales: 轉址是技術行為，不會擴充授權。
新目標未列入授權，需先確認再測試。
未登入仍可能發出不在範圍內的測試。
尚未測試的資產沒有驗證證據。

en.prompt: Authorization covers only staging, which redirects to an unlisted service. What next?
options: Follow it because the redirect is automatic
Stop that action and confirm scope
Test it as long as you do not log in
Mark both domains as verified
rationales: A redirect is a technical action, not an extension of permission.
The new target is not authorized; confirm before testing.
Unauthenticated requests can still be out of scope.
There is no verification evidence for an untested asset.

zh.prompt: 哪項 ROE 最能避免執行歧義？
options: 請盡量安全
測試我們的網站
列明主機、動作、時段、禁止事項及聯絡人
工具預設值就是範圍
rationales: 方向正確但沒有可判斷的界線。
網站與方法仍不明確。
可核對欄位讓執行者知道何時可以行動或應停止。
工具設定不代表資產所有者授權。

en.prompt: Which ROE statement best prevents execution ambiguity?
options: Please be safe
Test our website
Name hosts, actions, window, prohibitions and contact
Use tool defaults as the scope
rationales: The intention is useful but lacks decision boundaries.
The assets and methods remain unclear.
Checkable fields tell the operator when to act or stop.
Tool settings do not represent the asset owner’s permission.

zh.prompt: 看見疑似個資後，哪份紀錄最適當？
options: 記錄必要線索、停止並按約定通報
下載全部資料證明嚴重性
刪除所有紀錄避免麻煩
宣稱整個系統已被攻陷
rationales: 保留必要證據與執行停止規則能支持後續處理。
大量下載可能增加不必要的暴露及超出授權。
任意刪除會失去可追查的處理證據。
單一觀察不足以支持整體入侵結論。

en.prompt: After seeing possible personal data, which record is most appropriate?
options: Record necessary clues, stop and report as agreed
Download everything to prove severity
Delete all records to avoid trouble
Declare the entire system compromised
rationales: Minimal evidence and the agreed stop rule support follow-up handling.
Bulk downloading can increase exposure and exceed permission.
Arbitrary deletion removes the evidence needed to reconstruct the response.
One observation does not establish full system compromise.
